from collections import namedtuple

# Constraints with linear expressions.
# constr_id is used to recover dual variables.
# expr == 0
LinEqConstr = namedtuple("LinEqConstr", ["expr",
                                         "constr_id",
                                         "shape"])
# expr <= 0
LinLeqConstr = namedtuple("LinLeqConstr", ["expr",
                                           "constr_id",
                                           "shape"])
